history.summary: No published history of this maath was found. The only documented Chaitanya Mahaprabhu temple in Karnal district is the Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu Gaudiya Maath listed at Yamuna bridge, NH 709A, Gharaunda Sub-District (Karnal district), about 15 km north of Karnal town - so the CSV town 'Karnal' is corrected to Gharaunda and the name to the documented maath name (verify: the CSV's 'Chaitanya Mahaprabhu Mandir' may refer to this maath or to another unlisted shrine). It belongs to the Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition of Chaitanya Mahaprabhu (1486-1534), the 15th-century saint born in Nabadwip, Bengal, who is worshipped by followers as an incarnation of Krishna and whose teachings centre on congregational chanting of the Hare Krishna maha-mantra. The map listing reports daily hours 5:00 AM - 9:00 PM. Coordinates are from the place listing (29.596545, 77.109128), not an on-site survey - verify.
